preparation.text: Start from your current game completions. Every unfinished required achievement counts, including earlier ranks.
Start long counters while learning the encounter. Check each task’s exact mode, scale, kit and restriction.
Use group size from the game to check exemptions. Confirm the actual party on a task card for scheduling.
Keep a ready solo task for time between sessions. Restore skipped or deferred tasks when ready.

14.condition: Deal all damage to Kree'arra with a salamander.
14.plan: Bring a usable salamander, its matching tar and ranged protection. Keep recoil, thralls, poison and alternate boss damage out. Step under safely and handle adds without splashing damage onto Kree.
14.attempts: A non-salamander boss hit breaks the kill. Restock or repeat with a clean loadout. Keep this separate from the 30-kill method unless supplies support a deliberate composite trip.

mode.practiceAward: standard repeatable encounter planned; other modes unverified

kitNotes: Bring enough matching tar for the whole kill. About 200 is a starting estimate for Tecu.

15.condition: Kill Kree'arra 30 times in one privately rented room without leaving.
15.plan: Rent the correct Armadyl room. Benchmark a five-kill sustain sample. Use chin positioning if owned and repeatable, or a proven high-end Kree setup, with enough ammunition, prayer and healing for 30.
15.attempts: Leaving or death resets the streak. If supply projection after 5–10 kills is poor, complete other room flags and increase sustain or purchase a new rental next time.

mode.practiceAward: standard repeatable encounter planned; other modes unverified

21.plan: Use a ranged or magic route with offset mage and ranged minion attacks; remove a dangerous minion at a safe transition or flick each. Track consecutive clean kills separately from ordinary KC.
21.attempts: A single minion-damage hit resets the clean pair. Stay in the rental and start the pair again on the next useful respawn.

94.condition: Grotesque Guardians full kill strictly before 1:20.
94.plan: Bring a fast ranged Dawn switch, strong Dusk melee, and enough special damage to minimise transitions. Pre-position for movement and orbs. Train a fast first half before attempting the full time.
94.attempts: If an orb pickup, stun or slow transition consumed the margin, finish eligible assignment KC. Correct the delay before retrying.

100.plan: Use repeatable Corrupted prep (usually tier-1 or tier-2 armour by comfort with two reliable styles). Work toward personal timer splits while sourcing crystal armour and an enhanced seed.
100.attempts: A normal Gauntlet clear is separate. If prep timeout or repeated tornado contact ends runs, trade speed for stable armour and food until clear rate improves.

mode.practiceAward: use named portal

kitNotes: Count up to 50 corrupted clears while gathering crystal equipment. Estimate time from the remaining clears at your usual pace.

104.condition: Clear Corrupted Gauntlet without making an egniol potion.
104.plan: Start at full prayer with clean style changes, conserve prayer with lazy flicks, fish extra paddlefish, and skip all potion production. Use a familiar armour tier and two strong damage options.
104.attempts: Creating any potion invalidates the run even if never drunk. Start fresh for this flag or finish ordinary KC.

106.condition: Clear Corrupted Hunllef after making at most one attuned weapon.
106.plan: Build one perfected weapon via the sole attuned upgrade and keep a basic secondary. Trade food time for slower off-style damage, or use 5:1 only once consistent.
106.attempts: If you upgrade a second frame to attuned, use the run for KC. Practise 5:1 in an ordinary clear before making it the default.

108.attempts: A slow route can become crystal-farm KC. Log prep and boss splits separately, then optimise whichever consumes most of the deficit.

118.attempts: If an essential drop or layout costs the prep split, reset only if time is the sole objective. Avoid combining the normal timer with any Corrupted flag.

143.condition: Defeat Hydra using only Dharok's greataxe as a weapon while HP never exceeds 10.
143.plan: Bring an eligible Hydra assignment and the greataxe. Set HP before aggro, avoid passive regeneration above 10 and stop recoil/thrall or other unverified damage. Full Dharok is an optional damage amplifier.
143.attempts: A missed prayer or vent can kill a low-HP player. Schedule this deliberately and separately from speed and Hardcore default work. If HP ticks over 10, use the kill for KC and reset correctly.

151.condition: Clear Fight Caves with zero healing of Jad by healers.
151.plan: Choose a known spawn, lure Jad towards the entrance if appropriate, and tag each healer early with a long-range Bowfa, crystal or other eligible bow. Prioritise prayer between tags.
151.attempts: A single heal invalidates the flag. Keep Jad contained and finish KC. Avoid relog or hopping mid-run for this objective, per the task strategy.

154.condition: Finish Fight Caves without losing prayer points.
154.plan: Use safe tiles, lazy flick magers and Jad, and avoid bat contact entirely. High prayer bonus and ranged supplies help. Do not use deliberate drain to test setup.
154.attempts: A Tz-Kih hit can fail the flag even when the point display does not drop. Finish useful KC and rehearse late waves with the fail notification enabled.

156.attempts: If early waves slip, use the run for #151 or another eligible flag. Keep the zero-drain run separate until ordinary pace is reliably fast.

186.condition: Solo standard Nightmare, with parasites healing her for at most 100 HP in total.
186.plan: Bring Relicym's balm or Sanfew. Anticipate parasites in phase two, dose before the burst, step under the boss as the parasite spawns and kill the weakened parasite immediately.
186.attempts: If total healing exceeds 100, the next kill requires a fresh attempt. Log how many clean attacks occur before the burst to improve timing.
